question: Is there a licence-clean forearm/wrist/hand muscle donor available to this programme?
answer: NO. Every wrist-muscled model on disk is one artefact whose rights holders' own licence forbids copying, forbids distribution and restricts use to non-commercial academic work. The one upper-limb donor released without a non-commercial restriction is not on disk and is behind a login wall.
nothing_was_copied_or_derived: No muscle, path point, parameter or number from any model below appears in any file produced by this work. data/raw/ is gitignored and `git ls-files data/raw` returns zero tracked files, so this repository does not redistribute any of them.

on_disk.census_basis: every .osim in the repository parsed; 1641 files, 414 unique by content (data/raw = 215); a candidate counts only if a muscle PATH touches a carpal or metacarpal body, not if a coordinate is merely named for the wrist

candidates.credits: Gonzalez, R.V., Buchanan, T.S., Delp, S.L.
candidates.publications: How muscle architecture and moment arms affect wrist flexion-extension moments. Journal of Biomechanics, vol. 30, pp. 705-712, 1997.
candidates.licence_text_inside_the_file: NONE. A grep for licen|copyright|creative|commons|BSD|MIT|apache over the file returns zero hits.

candidates.muscle_law: Schutte1993Muscle (legacy tag, no _Deprecated suffix; a census grepping only the modern class names reports ZERO forces here)

unusable_because: placeholder credits; docs/UPPER_BODY_ACTUATION.md section 10.3 established that its derivative author granted nothing findable and the ULB download page shows no licence at all
the radiocarpal is a one-DOF PinJoint: flexion only, NO deviation coordinate exists to drive
both wrist coordinates ship <locked>true</locked> at -1.57079632 rad

You are responsible for testing its accuracy in the context of your planned application. We make no guarantees as to its suitability for your particular application.

operative_licence.comparison_to_mobl_arms: STRICTER. MoBL-ARMS 4.1's SimTK notice is BSD-3 restricted to non-commercial use, which at least permits redistribution with the notice. This one forbids copying and distribution outright.

the_apache_copy_is_not_a_second_opinion.claim_rejected: that the opensim-core copies are covered by opensim-core's Apache-2.0 LICENSE.txt
the_apache_copy_is_not_a_second_opinion.why: this is the exact error docs/UPPER_BODY_ACTUATION.md section 10.1(4) recorded for MoBL-ARMS: reading a repository's own licence as covering a model somebody else contributed to it. The repository says otherwise itself.
the_apache_copy_is_not_a_second_opinion.opensim_core_notice_carve_out: If you use plugins, models, or other components contributed by your fellow researchers, you must acknowledge their work as described in the license that accompanies each of these files.
the_apache_copy_is_not_a_second_opinion.and_the_credits_are_placeholders: so the opensim-core copies do not even carry the attribution condition 1 requires

the_donor_that_would_be_clean.name: Stanford-VA upper limb model (Holzbaur, Murray, Delp 2005)
the_donor_that_would_be_clean.licence: BSD 3-Clause. Copyright (c) 2005, Stanford University and VA Palo Alto Health Care System. All rights reserved.
the_donor_that_would_be_clean.citation_required: Holzbaur KRS, Murray WM, Delp SL. A model of the upper extremity for simulating musculoskeletal surgery and analyzing neuromuscular control. Annals of Biomedical Engineering 2005; 33: 829-840.
the_donor_that_would_be_clean.acquisition_blocked_by: https://simtk.org/frs/download_confirm.php/file/1131/UpperExtremityModel.zip?group_id=324 returns 197 bytes of HTML redirecting to /account/login.php?triggered=1 -- the same login wall docs/SHOULDER_GIRDLE.md section 1.4 hit at 216 bytes for the thoracoscapular package and docs/UPPER_BODY_ACTUATION.md section 10.1 hit for MoBL-ARMS
the_donor_that_would_be_clean.note: Arm26, already registered in this plant, is this model's educational reduction and names the same paper. The catalog remark that it has 'no inertial properties for the bodies' does not bear on this use: this plant supplies its own radius, ulna and hand inertia and would take only paths and parameters.

registration_cost_once_a_donor_is_cleare.finding: against a Rajagopal/Holzbaur-lineage donor the frame map is EXACT arithmetic, not a fit
registration_cost_once_a_donor_is_cleare.evidence: this plant's arm bodies are Rajagopal's own bones through OpenSim's ScaleTool, which records the factors it used. RajagopalLaiUhlrich2023.osim's radius_hand_r offset (-0.008797, -0.235841, 0.01361) times this model's own radius_r <Mesh><scale_factors> (1.0693436226, 1.0010835523, 1.0916949738) reproduces this plant's offset (-0.009407015848012, -0.236096546057984, 0.014857968593418) with a componentwise difference of exactly 0.0
registration_cost_once_a_donor_is_cleare.corroboration: this plant's wrist ranges, inherited from RajagopalLaiUhlrich2023's own radius_hand, are +-1.22173048 and -0.43633231..0.61086524 rad; the Gonzalez model declares the same two ranges to six decimals
registration_cost_once_a_donor_is_cleare.same_rule_already_audited_by: scripts/build_corrected_foot.py check C3, over 19 joint offsets
what_would_still_be_work: the Gonzalez wrist is two coupled carrier bodies plus welded carpals where this plant is a single UniversalJoint, so the two DOFs must be identified rather than copied
Schutte1993 is a deprecated law; either it travels or the parameters are re-expressed under a current one and that is declared
the left side is a reflection prior needing the explicit validation docs/SHOULDER_GIRDLE.md section 4 shows is not optional
